  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  tag TEXT,
  sent_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  well_id TEXT,
  alarm_id TEXT,
  channel VARCHAR(32)
);
